name: CCA 1368(印度口音)跑线 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 368, a flight from Shenzhen to Beijing, your weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, contact Beijing Approach and request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 368，从 Shenzhen 到 Beijing，气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，联系北京进近，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 PEK VOR。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, our weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，我们的气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 PEK VOR。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Beijing Approach, radar contact, negative due prohibited area, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，北京进近，雷达识别，因禁区不批准，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, when clear of weather, fly direct to AA443.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，天气解除后，直飞 AA443。
cards.referenceText: When clear of weather, fly direct to AA443, CCA 1368.

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, turn right, direct to AA442, hold at AA442 as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，右转，直飞 AA442，按公布程序在 AA442 等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to AA442, hold at AA442 as published, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 AA442，按公布程序在 AA442 等待，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, orbit right from present position until advised, Runway 18L is not available now.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，跑道 18L 现在不可用。
cards.referenceText: Roger, orbit right from present position until advised, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbit, you find the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, report it to Beijing Approach and request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 经过几圈盘旋后，你发现机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，向北京进近报告，请求离开等待并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，请求离开等待，并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, after this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, you have received information S, tell Beijing Approach you are ready for approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 PEK 上空，保持 4200 米，已收到信息 S，告诉 北京进近 你准备进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, information S, ready for approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，过 PEK，保持 4200 米，信息 S，准备进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Beijing Approach, follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，北京进近，执行 PEK-05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 PEK-05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the ILS signals of Runway 01, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已截获跑道 01 的 ILS 信号，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, established ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，已建立跑道 01 ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Runway 01, cleared to land.
B: During final approach, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, you executed a missed approach, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，你执行复飞，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，复飞。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK600 米等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 600 米等待，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have landed on Runway 01, you find the runway surface is slippery, the braking action is medium, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已在跑道 01 着陆，发现跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, the runway surface is slippery, the breaking action is medium.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, roger, thanks, vacate Runway 01 via rapid exit E2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，收到，谢谢，经快速出口 E2 脱离跑道 01。
cards.referenceText: Vacate Runway 01 via rapid exit E2, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经快速出口 E2 脱离跑道 01，CCA 1368。
